items.title: General Mills Soars 5% With Packaged Food as Kraft Heinz Calls 2027 Price Hikes “Likely”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysGeneral Mills shares rose 5% today with Campbell’s, Conagra and Smucker after Kraft Heinz said price increases are likely in 2027. Investors are betting packaged-food makers can pass rising costs on to shoppers.

items.title: Kraft Heinz earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Kraft Heinz Co (KHC) is trading at $25.94 (+5.77%) as of Nov 4, 12:26 PM EST. Q3 2026 adjusted EPS was $0.53 against a $0.42 estimate, a 26.2% surprise. Revenue was $6.12B against $6.08B. The profit beat was larger than the sales beat. Management said trade and marketing timing added about 450 basis points to operating profit versus expectations.
